components.name: Exact basis acquisition
components.operation: Read all columns with n forward products or all rows with m transpose products, choosing the smaller count.

Charge a block by its number of columns; do not call it one query.

components.full_local_argument: Basis acquisition reconstructs A exactly. In its SVD A=U Sigma V^T, set P=V_k V_k^T with an orthonormal rank-k completion if necessary. Then A(I−P) deletes the first k singular components. For any rank-k right projector P_*, the min-max singular-value separation gives sigma_j(A(I−P_*))≥sigma_{k+j}(A) for 1≤j≤N−k. Taking the l_p norm, or maximum at infinity, lower-bounds every competing residual by the tail achieved by P. Hence the returned P attains OPT exactly, and therefore satisfies every positive-epsilon relative target deterministically. This is the local linear-algebra justification of the source's exact-recovery upper witness, relative to standard singular-value separation.
components.goal: Convert the recovered matrix to the specified right-projector output.
components.key_estimate: If singular values are sigma_1≥…≥sigma_N≥0, the residual has tail singular values sigma_{k+1},…,sigma_N. This attains the orthogonal rank-k minimum: its Schatten-p norm is (sum_{j>k}sigma_j^p)^(1/p), or sigma_{k+1} for infinity.
components.name: Optimal right singular projection
components.operation: Choose the top-k right singular subspace and form its orthogonal projector with measurable tie breaking.
components.requires: Free exact internal singular-value computations; rank-k completion allowed.
transfer_checks: An approximate numerical SVD requires a separate precision/error argument.

variants.cost: Exactly N individual one-sided products; internal SVD, arithmetic and storage are uncharged in the paper's oracle model. This is not a runtime bound.
variants.name: Smaller-side basis recovery
variants.output: A rank-k right orthogonal projector attaining OPT_{p,k}(A) simultaneously for every Schatten p in [1,infinity].
public_inputs: Any Schatten p in [1,infinity] and epsilon>0 if an approximation target is requested
variants.query_and_update: If n≤m, for j=1,…,n query A e_j and store it as column j. If m<n, for i=1,…,m query A^T e_i and store its transpose as row i. Having recovered A, compute its singular value decomposition. Select k orthonormal right singular vectors associated with the k largest singular values and form P=V_k V_k^T. Complete within zero singular subspaces when rank(A)<k, with fixed measurable tie breaking.
variants.requirements: Exact Av and A^T u queries for arbitrary real vectors; uncharged computation/storage and exact internal linear algebra. No rank or spectral promise on A.
variants.state_and_initialization: Allocate storage for A, initially unknown; construct the standard basis on the smaller side. Fix a measurable singular-vector/tie-breaking rule.
variants.tuning_and_stopping: Exactly N basis queries, followed by internal linear algebra; no accuracy-dependent tuning or randomized stopping.
